_comment: Car-seat stroller adapter fragment. Sourced 2026-07-05 (batch S10). Shared Switchback adapter serving BOTH the &Jog and &Roll Switchback frames. Do NOT edit seed.json.
name: Veer Switchback Infant Car Seat Adapter (Cybex / Maxi-Cosi / Nuna / Clek)
seatBrandsSupported: Cybex (Aton Q & M), Maxi-Cosi (Mico Max 30, Mico 30, Nxt, Mico AP), Nuna (PIPA lite lx, PIPA lite, PIPA RX, PIPA), and Clek (Liing) — Clek Liing explicitly listed. NOT compatible with Stokke PIPA by Nuna.

status.clekNote: Clek lists this single 'Switchback Infant Car Seat Adapter – Cybex/Maxi-Cosi/Nuna' for both 'Switchback & Jog' and 'Switchback & Roll (Single or Double)'; the Roll double mode also needs Veer's Second-seat adapter kit.

install.pieces: single adapter (one unit); &Roll accepts up to 2 adapters when used with the separate Second Seat Adapter Kit
install.notes: Attaches to the &Roll or &Jog Switchback frame; car seat mounts front- or rear-facing. On &Jog, holds 1 infant car seat. On &Roll, one adapter for single; two adapters plus the Second Seat Adapter Kit for two car seats in double mode.

notes: adapter-veer-switchback serves BOTH veer-switchback-jog and veer-switchback-roll; double mode needs a second-seat kit. Single adapter, tool-free. Clek Liing explicitly supported. No printed part number on Clek's list or retailer pages — partNumber null. $59 (Baby Cubby, sold out at check; Albee Baby in stock; Veer DTC also lists $59). Two adapters + Second Seat Adapter Kit required to run two infant car seats on the &Roll double.
